# Isaiah Chapter 19 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 25 verses]*

*LORD rides cloud to Egypt; civil war; Nile dries; future blessing — Egypt, Assyria, Israel together*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 19 (Oracle Against Egypt) addresses lord rides cloud to egypt; civil war; nile dries; future blessing — egypt, assyria, israel together. The key verse — "In that day there will be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to First Isaiah (chs. 1-39), focused on judgment and the Assyrian crisis.
